raw_source.text_snippet: URV burden analyses were performed using four filtering strategies based on two criteria: (1) variant frequency—either all URVs or singleton-only variants; (2) variant impact—either only high-impact variants (nonsense, splice acceptor/donor and frameshift mutations) or both high- and moderate-impact variants (missense mutations, in-frame deletions and UTR truncations). Burden analyses were performed by testing for an association between ALS status and the aggregate effect of minor alleles observed per sample per functional unit using Firth's logistic regression with profile penalized likelihood confidence intervals
